source: Relax Raid DESIGN sections 7 and 9, DEC-03; PHASE1-BRIEF R4 and 'R6 and R7 on main 6208b16', superseded where stated by 'Raid 1 gets a score' (architect ruling, 20 November). These are starting values, not calibrated. rounding_step=0.1: PLAN 4A row 7. gcd_ms=1500 and gcd_energy_ms=1000: architect reports second-log cast-gap peaks at 1.4-1.5 s and 0.9-1.0 s respectively; energy interval for cast PowerType 3. healer.low_health_fraction=0.5, death.lost_boss_gap_ms=4000, owned_death=40, boss_swing_taken=2 and output/activity/mechanics measure_weights: guesses, to tune in the silent first raid. death.summary_window_ms=10000: same as death.window_ms. confidence.provisional_min_coverage=0.15, preparation weights stock=30/bag_gear=30/used=40 and better_item_in_bags=25: architect-ruled starting values for raid 1. output.boss_damage applies to DPS and tank peers; used remains unmeasured until a consumable aura map exists. new_at_60_seconds stays null: prep-report label, not a score. PHASE1-BRIEF 'R6: four predicates DESIGN 8 left open': death.full_health_fraction=0.9, death.min_health_samples=2, death.raidwide_share=0.6, death.raidwide_window_ms=2000 are architect guesses to tune after raid 1. 'R7: three gaps found by the builder' supersedes the provisional threshold with 0.15 so a lone tank can receive a provisional score without an invented baseline; validation remains 0 < p < min_coverage. PHASE1-BRIEF 'R6: rules 3 and 4 bounded': death.pulled_aggro_ms=10000: architect guess to bound the time from first damage to the killing run; tune after raid 1. Round-2 ruling: activity_cast_cap_ms=10000 moves the existing completed-cast interval cap into replaceable scoring data, not a calibrated value. Null parameters are unconfigured: consumers must leave that measure unmeasured, never substitute zero.
